function_or_problem: Conformity assurance and cross-border type approval
configurational_evidence: CEPT specification drafting is coordinated by Commission; approved laboratories test and certify; certificates are recognized for type approval without further tests in covered cases; national authorities approve and can suspend/revoke; Commission has a specification withdrawal safeguard
inferential_rule: Complementary relations form a sequence and safeguard around the same defined object and purpose; not a count of actors or provisions
architectural_significance: Certificate recognition has consequential effect on duplicate testing and type approval while decision and safeguard capacities remain distributed among laboratory national authority Commission/Committee
